displayTitle: The Boy Who Went to the North Wind and Demanded His Meal Back
description: An English retelling that stays close to the original Scandinavian folktale: a poor boy confronts the personified North Wind, receives three enchanted gifts, and outwits a thieving innkeeper to win back justice for what was stolen.
tone: Folktale; brisk, witty, and morally satisfying, with a touch of magical menace
summary: A poor boy tracks down the North Wind for stealing his meal and returns home with magical gifts that expose a thief and set things right.
